title: Delete the dead app_database_test.dart.skip and dao_merge_methods_test.dart.skip
why: Both files import lib/core/database/app_database.dart, which does not exist anywhere in the repo — it was split into ContentDatabase/UserDatabase/DeviceRegistryDatabase per commit ce43a2d9. Both also use a pre-split schema (sefariaRef typed as `int`, schemaVersion 3) that predates today's text-keyed CompletionEvents. The `.dart.skip` extension means flutter test's `*_test.dart` glob never sees these files at all — they're not 'skipped tests', they're 1032 combined lines of uncompilable dead code with zero CI signal. The last touch was a 'fix: DNI-79 Complete compilation error fixes and code cleanup' commit, implying they were parked rather than deleted because they wouldn't compile, and nobody has revisited them since. An agent searching test/core/database/ for existing CompletionDao merge/dedup coverage will find these, spend time working out why they don't run, and only then discover the class they test was deleted long ago.
recommendation: Delete both files. If CompletionDao merge/dedup behavior (completionExists, insert dedup) isn't covered by a current test, add fresh coverage at the mirrored path against CompletionDao directly instead of the deleted AppDatabase.
acceptance_criteria: Both .dart.skip files are removed (or their commit message states why any surviving assertions were ported first, per TQ-7).
An audit check bans new *.dart.skip/*.skip files under test/ going forward.

corrections: Cited rule AG-6 (TODO/FIXME + commented-code) doesn't literally match; content is neither. Better justified under the digest's separate 'dead code' Everything-sweep category, which the finding still satisfies.
